en.title: Maximum Positive Difference of a Later Element Minus an Earlier Element
en.description:
Among element pairs with i<j and a[j]>a[i], find the maximum of a[j]−a[i]; if there is no valid pair, output 0.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: The input is n followed by n integers. The original had no numeric bounds; this site adds 0≤n≤200000 and elements in −10^9..10^9; an empty array also outputs 0.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 5; 0; 0. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Scan from left to right maintaining the minimum so far; each element only tries to pair with that earlier minimum.
